title: PDF documents
name: Document name
invalid: Check the document name, language and layout values. Your edits are kept here.
desktop: Open this workspace in the desktop application to preview and export PDFs.
historyIntro: Restoring an edition keeps later editions in the history.
previewOld: Updating the preview to the saved edition.
layoutNote: The document layout applies to every section unless a section uses its own layout.
layoutCopy: Apply a layout to copy its settings. Changing or removing a saved layout keeps existing documents unchanged.
nameLayout: Enter a name for this layout.
previewSaving: Waiting for your edits to finish saving.
researchIntro: Choose exactly which saved content to include. A retained copy stays with this document, including its selected figures. Later source edits appear only when you review and accept them.
sourceUnchanged: The selected source content is unchanged.
localSourceEdits: This document has local edits. Accepting the source replaces this section with the incoming content; the current edition remains in history.
sourceFiguresChanged: The selected figure data or presentation has changed. Review the incoming figures below.
ownerContent: Content in this workspace or project
preflightReview: Review these findings before distributing this document.
preflightTruncated: More findings remain. Correct the listed problems and check again.
preflightScope: These checks cover measured layout, image resolution and link destinations. They do not certify accessibility, archival or commercial-print standards.
printUrls: Show external URLs in the text
imageMissingAlt: Describe the image before adding it.
imageBlock: Place after text block (0 = before text)
noteMissingContent: Enter note content before adding it.
noteSectionHelp: Section notes appear after this section, not at the bottom of each page.
pageMasterHint: Use {page}, {pages} or {section} in header and footer text. Section titles use separate page styles and start on a new page. The starting number applies to the document.
firstPageHeader: Show header on the first page
firstPageFooter: Show footer on the first page
sourceImageIntro: Choose an image, then describe it for this document.
sourceImageEmpty: No supported image files on this page.
audiencePrivateHint: Private editions include current content unless a section is omitted.
audiencePublicHint: Review each included section before preparing a public edition. Unreviewed sections block preparation.
audienceChanged: Content or document settings changed. Review again.
audienceReviewHint: Check the selected text, images, notes, figures and document settings for private details or local paths before marking them reviewed.
audienceSummary: {included} included, {omitted} omitted, {pending} awaiting public review ({total} sections)
compositionIntro: Arrange text and images on a single page, or let the section flow across pages.
compositionColumns: Positioned pages need one column. Adjust the layout to continue.
compositionBounds: Some items extend outside the page. Adjust their positions or sizes.
compositionStale: Content has changed. Adjust the layout to include every item.
compositionOverlap: Some items overlap. Check their placement in the PDF preview.
compositionReady: Every item has a place on this page.
compositionHelp: Drag a block to move it. Use arrow keys for precise movement, or Shift with an arrow for a larger step.
compositionAuthority: This canvas shows placement. Preview PDF to inspect the actual text, images and page breaks.
outlineEmpty: No matching sections in this range.
outlineStart: Search section titles or choose a position for the current section.
pagePreviewError: Page thumbnails could not be loaded.
imageOutputDpi: Export resolution (dpi; blank keeps original pixels)
imageQualitySummary: At the entered dimensions: {before} to {after} pixels; {beforeBytes} to {afterBytes} bytes; {dpi} dpi. Page composition can change the displayed size; Preview PDF shows the final layout. The retained original is unchanged.
pageReferences: Show page numbers in contents and lists
paginationPositioned: Flow pagination controls are unavailable on positioned pages. Switch to flowing layout to use the retained settings.
paginationStale: The content structure changed. Adjust the saved pagination rules to continue.
paginationEmpty: Add paragraphs or headings to set their pagination.
paginationHelp: Choose a paragraph, heading or list and control how it breaks across pages.
paginationOrphans: Minimum lines before a page break
paginationWidows: Minimum lines after a page break
paginationAuthority: Preview the PDF to check page breaks. A block taller than a page may still need to split.
crossReferenceHelp: Choose a section, figure or table to append a reference to your content. Enable its numbering in Contents and references or Captions and lists. The exported reference follows the current order.
